SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_018A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Through the caves...
There's more bunkers up ahead.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_027A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to knock out those bunkers!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_034A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our tanks are moving up...
Convoy won't be far behind...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_035A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7That our objective?
It's a damn  fortress!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_039A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Roebuck! We can flank 'em!
I see paths around either side!!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_102A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You know what to do! Bring 'em down!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_103A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get to it, Miller! Take out that bunker!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_105A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get some damn fire on those bunkers!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_112A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover. Let's get through this...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_115A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The Major's convoy is en route.
After this, we'll be on easy street.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_123A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Now let's get out of this damn hole
and start dealing with our wounded...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_123A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Now let's get out of this hole
and start dealing with our wounded...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_000A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Keep moving you animals...
You're running out of places to hide...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_002A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Hold on kid, we're gonna get you out of here.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_003A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Help me get him on the truck.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_006A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7It's not bad, okay? It's not bad.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_008A_MAJG.en: ^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Push ahead and take Shuri Castle.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_010A_MAJG.en:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7You'll have a supply drop
tomorrow morning.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_011A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Tomorrow?!!...
How the hell are we supposed to hold out till tomorrow?!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_011A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Tomorrow?!!...
How are we supposed to hold out till tomorrow?!

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_013A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear this, Sarge?
We ain't getting shit 'til tomorrow morning.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_013A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear this, Sarge?
We ain't getting nothin' 'til tomorrow morning.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_014A_MAJG.en:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Intel says Shuri Castle
is mostly deserted.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_016A_MAJG.en:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Look on the bright side...
After this, you boys will probably get relieved
and be on the boat home...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_017B_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Yeah? That's what we
thought after Peleliu...

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_500A_COR2.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7You have to stay calm, okay?

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_501A_COR2.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7You're conscious and alert,
that's a good sign... Trust me.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_503A_COR2.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Keep pressure on the wound, okay?

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_000A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Soon as that supply drop shows, we move.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_003A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7This is all we've got. Share it out.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_008A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7They must have been waiting all night!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_009A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7They won't be the only ones... eyes wide.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_013A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They zeroed our position pretty damn quick...
There must be spotters holed up in the tunnels.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_013A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They zeroed our position pretty quick...
There must be spotters holed up in the tunnels.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_018A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Good luck. We'll regroup on the other side!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_019A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Dammit, Miller...
I almost plugged you there!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_020A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Come on.
We're pushing deeper into the castle.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_027A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover and take it out!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_029A_ROEB_A.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Push forward!
We've got to take out those mortars!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_031A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7I want men moving up each side! GO!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_036A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7One down! Get to the next one!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_038A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7There's more mortar pits beyond the wall!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_039A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Blow up the gatehouse!
Bring down that barricade!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_100A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get to it, Miller! Take out that Mortar pit!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_200A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Word is, the main force
pulled back to the north ridge..

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_201A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7...But I want everyone ready to fight.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_202A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the grass... Watch the trees...
Watch any damn place Tojo could be waiting.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_202A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the grass... Watch the trees...
Watch any place Tojo could be waiting.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_203A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Our planes bombed
the shit outta the place...

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_204A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They'll be back.
Soon as they're refueled and rearmed.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_218A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Use the enemy's weapons if you have to!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_222A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Grab a mortar shell and throw it!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_223A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Clear the area before we move up!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_226A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We got another MG on our left flank!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_230A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Planes should be en route to assist.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_231A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Good...
They can blow this place to kingdom come.

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_255A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Looks like our planes
did most of the work...

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_305A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7You're all going to hell, y'hear me???

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_305A_POLO_SAFE.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7You're all going to die, y'hear me???

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_306A_POLO_SAFE.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7I'm going to kill every last one of you!!!!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_316A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear that?
Call in those fucking planes!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_316A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear that?
Call in those planes!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_319A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Do it, Miller! Call in those planes!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_341A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You hear that? Call in the planes!

SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_501A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We can throw their own
mortars right on them!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_005A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Damn right they're re-supplying the enemy!
Decks are loaded with ammunition!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_005A_LAUG_SAFE.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Darn right they're re-supplying the enemy!
Decks are loaded with ammunition!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_009A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Concentrate on their cargo!
Blow that shit up!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_009A_LAUG_SAFE.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Concentrate on their cargo!
Blow it all up!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_012A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Small arms fire coming
from the decks!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_014A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Aim for the fuel barrels on deck.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_026A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7What the fuck are merchant ships
doing with that much firepower?!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_026A_LAUG_SAFE.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7What are merchant ships
doing with that much firepower?!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_029A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We still got those support boats to deal with.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_041A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Shit!   Tell me we've not lost our gunner!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_041A_BOOT_SAFE.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Tell me we've not lost our gunner!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_043A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Shit!!!  Anyone see flak guns
on that first pass?!!!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_043A_LAUG_SAFE.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Anyone see flak guns on that first pass?!!!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_044A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7That must be some pretty important
cargo they're carrying.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_045A_LAUG.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7We need to get below the flak!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_047A_LAUG.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I can't line up a decent shot!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_049A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7I'll take us as close as we can...
We need to wrap this up! This is our last pass.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_055A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Good work, Locke.
You've saved a lot of lives on Okinawa.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_056A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Shit. I think we disabled them,
but they're still afloat.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_056A_LAUG_SAFE.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I think we disabled them,
but they're still afloat.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_057A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7I doubt the Japanese
can salvage anything...
Good enough, Locke.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_059A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Get some altitude. Headin' back to base.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_061A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7We got pretty roughed up on
that last run, Booth.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_061B_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7We got pretty roughed up on
that last run, Mantaray.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_062A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Confirmed, Harrington...
You got smoke comin' from your number two engine.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_062B_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Confirmed, Hammerhead...
You got smoke comin' from your number two engine.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_063A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Gauges ain't hitting red...
We should be able to hold her...
As long as we don't run into any more
trouble with the enemy.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_065A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Captain... Distress call coming in...
The fleet's been hit, hard.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_065B_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Captain... Distress call coming in...
The fleet's been hit en route to Okinawa.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_067A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Request that all available crews participate
in rescue operations. They have men in the water...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_068A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Okay... Locke, seal the ventral hatch.
We'll be putting down on the ocean...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_073A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Take down as many of those
damn planes as you can!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_073A_BOOT_SAFE.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Take down as many of those
planes as you can!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_074A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Radio the fleet! Tell them Tojo's
headed right at them!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_076A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Your number two engine
is a ball of fire, shut it down!  Shut it down!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_077A_HARR.en: ^1HARRINGTON: ^7I am trying! The controls are shot to hell!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_077A_HARR_SAFE.en: ^1HARRINGTON: ^7I am trying! The controls are shot!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_078A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Hold it together, HARRINGTON!
HOLD IT TOGETHER!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_079A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Mayday! Mayday! 
We are going down, I say again we are going...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_081A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Okay people... the fleet still needs our help...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_084A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7We're going into a hot zone.
I want everyone sharp and ready for anything.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_085A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Bastards wiped out most of our ships.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_085A_BOOT_SAFE.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Animals wiped out most of our ships.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_086A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Holy shit... Do you think anyone's
gonna be alive down there?

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_086A_LAUG_SAFE.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Do you think anyone's gonna
be alive down there?

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_087A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7I see multiple casualties in the water.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_089A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7We better not be the only ones
responding to the distress call.
We ain't got room for all of them.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_090A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We'll do what we can... Taking us down.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_091A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7LOCKE!  Be ready to pull those men in.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_093A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7More of our boys in the water.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_095A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Sink those damn PT boats!
Before they rip our men to shreds!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_095A_LAND_SAFE.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Sink those PT boats! 
Before they rip our men to shreds!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_100A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We need to get to those men!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_101A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7They'll have to wait till we deal
with the PT boats...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_120A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Do you see anyone else in the water?

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_123A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin! Make sure we're not taking water!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_125A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Locke! Take his place on the dual 30.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_126A_LAUG.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Port side's pretty torn up, but we're holding!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_129A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Keep 'em off what's left of the fleet!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_130A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Locke! You need to take out
some of those Zeroes before I can take us up!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_131A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on that trigger. It's all on you...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_132B_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7This is Black Cat squadron leader
Mantaray 54...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_133A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7The fleet is down. Repeat the fleet is down!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_134A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We have multiple casualties in the water!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_137A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Landry! Any word on that air support?

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_139A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Keep trying...
We better pray that they show up!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_144A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Not yet, Laughlin.  We can't abandon our men!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_145A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7Laughlin!  Keep those planes off our men!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_146A_LAUG.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I'm trying!  There's too many of them!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_154A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Landry, get that man into a bunk!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_155A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Good work, Locke...
Landry, how we holding up?

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_156A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Hull's intact... Props spinning...
That's enough to get us outta here...

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_159A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7Bunk's are full...
Thanks to Locke, we got six men.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_160A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7We pulled five men on board...
Good job, Locke.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_161A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7Locke did pretty good... We got four.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_162A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7There were too many damn Zeroes...
We only got three.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_162A_LAND_SAFE.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7There were too many Zeroes...
We only got three.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_163A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We just got two and they're in a bad way.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_164A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We only got one... Let's pray he makes it.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_165A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We struck out... just get us out of here.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_167A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Oh no... NO! Landry. we got incoming!
12 O'Clock!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_168A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7It's the enemy...
And there's a fucking shitload of them.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_168A_BOOT_SAFE.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7It's the enemy...
And there's a whole bunch of them.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_200A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Harrington, take her in low!
We'll assault from above!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_200B_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Hammerhead, take her in low!
We'll assault from above!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_308A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Damn it, Locke!
Watch where you're aiming!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_314A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin, patch us up as best you can.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_406A_LAND.en:
^1LANDRY: ^7At least one Infantry transport ship
has already gone down.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_503A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I can see the wake behind them,
but not much else!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_506A_HARR.en:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Goddammit!!!
Sink them before they sink us!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_524A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the right turret!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_527A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the left turret!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_530A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Get up front! Maintain fire on those ships!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_531A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on those damn merchant ships!...
Head up front!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_531A_BOOT_SAFE.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on those merchant ships!...
Head up front!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_532A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the front turret!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_535A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the rear turret!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_536A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Get on the rear gun!
Taking MG fire on our six!!!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_538A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Are you hearing me?!!!
HIT THOSE MERCHANT SHIPS!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_542A_LAUG.en:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7We got smoke coming from
our number two engine!
